changeSet.author: club-management
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_is_active_club_member(target_club_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships WHERE club_id = target_club_id AND status = 'active' AND player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid()) ); $$;
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS fn_is_active_club_member(uuid);

match-submission
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_is_match_participant(target_match_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM match_participants WHERE match_id = target_match_id AND player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid()) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM matches WHERE id = target_match_id AND submitted_by_player_id IN ( SELECT id FROM player_profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() ) ); $$;
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS fn_is_match_participant(uuid);
